own_solution.law: Lossless LC charge transfer: v2 oscillates about Veq = (C1V1 + C2V2)/(C1+C2) from V2 with zero initial current, so V2max = 2 Veq - V2

defect_reasons.other: In the flash-unit sentences 'charged to the same voltage' has no clear referent; harmless because the sentence is disconnected.

notes: Authors' relation Vmax = 2 Veq - V2 agrees with my pass-1 method (Veq = 4200/50 = 84 V, Vmax = 148 V). Certified answers verified: q=7 uF: Veq = 4900/57 = 85.965, Vmax = 151.93 V; q=22: 6400/72 = 88.889, 157.78 V; q=35: 7700/85 = 90.588, 161.18 V. Inductance cancels (fixes only the time of the maximum). Minimal pairs T3614/T6868 (flash unit vs first capacitor) and T94A9/T0EC0 (earlier run vs this run) state 22 uF and differ only in attachment. Agrees with pass 1.
